description: Changes how user data is kept: tables (rows tied to a user), saves and visible (what other users may read of a user's saves). Waits in the draft until neblla_promote "save" (env "pro" for the users). Reading rows: neblla_table_query.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

saves.description: { maxBytesPerUser } (default 10 KB per user); null: the defaults.

tables.description: All the tables (replaces the set): { <name>: { fields: { <field>: string | number | integer | boolean | date }, index, … } }; null clears.

visible.description: What other users may read of a user's saves: { data: { <path>: "all" | "friends" }, tables: { <table>: … } }; replaces it; null: nothing.

name: neblla_update_app_storage
title: Change data storage settings
